title: Lena and the Gravity
author: Isandro Sterling
blurb: Elodie Nakamura, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
